title: Bslib card updates
description: This PR updates the `grid_card()` and associated functions to use the new `bslib::card()` function for more complex behavior than previously possible. The visual output will change a tiny bit and some arguments are now depreciated in favor of the more composition oriented api of `bslib::card()` as compared to the previous`gridlayout::grid_card()` interface. These changes are called out on runtime in order to help user's update their code effectively.

title: Make grid_card the base element of grid_card_text
description: Fixes bug from #13 where dot args were not actually being passed through to `grid_card()`. Changes are that the base element rather than just a div is now `grid_card()` with dots supplied.

title: Update to version `0.1.0`
description:
### Major new features and improvements

- `grid_card()` is now the main method of placing items onto the grid
- Added ability to add full-bleed header and sidebar with special child functions. These sit outside the main grid and can simplify layouts to not require them to constantly be added.
- General interface for cards is a lighter in favor of outputting most non-layout logic to the coming `bslib::card()` and friends. 

### Minor new features and improvements
- Website has been updated with better resources

title: Nested grid panel
description: Adds a new `nested_grid_panel()` card along with some `tagQuery()` logic to fix css namespaces whenever we have an auto-ided nested layout.

title: Grided modularization
description: A series of improvements to make the grided layout editor easier to use and maintain.

title: Live app editing
description:
Grided now has a mode that allows live editing of an existing app. 

There are also a few updates in this with regards to how css is parsed.

title: Switch to list internals
description: The internal data structure is now an element list rather than a matrix. This makes more complex layouts much easier to work with (e.g. overlapping elements, in the future dynamic grids).

title: Parcel conversion
description: javascript code for griditor is now built with parcel and typescript for easier development as project gets larger
